title: Symmetry
description: Class 7 IMO — Symmetry: line symmetry, rotational symmetry (order and angle), reflection symmetry, and symmetry in common shapes and letters.

topics.title: Line Symmetry
topics.concept: A shape has a line of symmetry if a line divides it into two matching halves. A square has 4 lines of symmetry, a rectangle 2, an equilateral triangle 3, and a circle has many.

examples.problem: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?

recap: A line of symmetry gives two matching halves.
Square 4, rectangle 2, equilateral triangle 3, circle many.

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
quiz.explanation: A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry.

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
quiz.explanation: A circle has infinitely many lines of symmetry.

topics.title: Rotational Symmetry
topics.concept: A shape has rotational symmetry if it looks the same after turning by some angle less than a full turn. The order is how many times it matches in a full turn, and the angle of rotation is 360° ÷ order. A square has order 4 and angle 90°.

examples.problem: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a square?
What is the order of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle?

recap: Order = number of matches in one full turn.

quiz.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a rectangle?
quiz.explanation: A rectangle matches twice in a full turn, so order 2.

quiz.q: The angle of rotation for a shape of order 4 is ___ ?

topics.title: Reflection Symmetry
topics.concept: Reflection symmetry is when one half is the mirror image of the other across a mirror line. Letters such as H, I, O and X have both vertical and horizontal lines of symmetry, while A has a vertical one.

examples.problem: Which letter has both vertical and horizontal symmetry: H or R?
A shape with rotational symmetry of order 6 is which regular shape?

recap: Reflection symmetry mirrors one half onto the other.
H, I, O, X have both vertical and horizontal symmetry.

quiz.q: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?
quiz.explanation: The letter A has a vertical line of symmetry.

quiz.q: A regular hexagon has rotational symmetry of order ___ ?

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle?
Which is the odd one out (three have a line of symmetry)?
questions.explanation: A scalene triangle has no line of symmetry.

questions.q: The angle of rotation equals 360° divided by the ___ ?
How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has 3 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a square?
questions.explanation: A square matches four times in a full turn.

questions.q: The angle of rotation for a square is ___ ?
The angle of rotation for a shape of order 6 is ___ ?
Which letter has both horizontal and vertical symmetry?
questions.explanation: H has both lines of symmetry.

questions.q: A wheel with 8 equal spokes has rotational symmetry of order ___ ?
A butterfly has a ___ line of symmetry.
questions.explanation: A butterfly has a vertical line of symmetry.

questions.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a regular hexagon?
How many lines of symmetry does a regular pentagon have?
questions.explanation: A regular pentagon has 5 lines of symmetry.
